$comment: Single source of truth for tool metadata. Run scripts/generate-docs.ps1 after edits.

tools.name: OutlineCSharpFile
tools.readme_summary: Signatures of every type and member — no bodies. Best for "what's in this file?"
tools.mcp_readme_description: skeleton of a file: types and member signatures, no bodies. Best for navigation ("what's in this file?").
tools.llms_summary: signatures of every type and member, no bodies (70–95% reduction)
tools.capabilities_desc: Skeleton of a C# file — every type and member as a signature, no bodies. Best for navigation and discovery.

tools.name: MinifyFile
tools.readme_summary: Lossless minify of an entire file — strips comments and whitespace, logic unchanged. Auto-dispatches by extension (C#, Razor, JS/TS, Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML, XML, C, C++, X++, VB.NET).
tools.mcp_readme_description: lossless minify of a whole file, auto-dispatched by extension. Calls the Roslyn minifier for C#/Razor (strips comments, `#region` directives, and whitespace; logic preserved verbatim); falls back to basic minification for other types.
tools.llms_summary: lossless minify, auto-dispatched by file extension
tools.capabilities_desc: Auto-dispatches by extension. Covers every supported language — JS/TS, Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML, XML, C, C++, and more. Falls back to lexical stripping for non-C# types.
tools.example_prompt: Read App.csproj — why is this package reference here?

tools.name: TraceDiRegistrations
tools.readme_summary: Finds every Dependency-Injection registration referencing a type (interface or concrete) and returns a compact table of `file:line`, method, `ServiceType -> ImplType`, and key. Answers "where is IFoo wired, and to what?"
tools.mcp_readme_description: finds every Dependency-Injection registration referencing a type (interface or concrete) and returns a compact table: `file:line`, method, `ServiceType -> ImplType`, and keyed key. Answers "where is IFoo wired, and to what implementation?" — the question a constructor caller-trace can't, since DI-built types are never `new`-ed.
tools.llms_summary: find where a type is registered in dependency injection and what it's wired to
tools.capabilities_desc: Finds every Dependency-Injection registration for a type and returns a compact table — file:line, lifetime, and service → implementation. Answers "where is this wired, and to what?", which a constructor search can't, since DI types are never newed.
tools.example_prompt: Where is IOrderRepository registered, and what's it wired to?
